name: Botlek
wikipediaExtract: Botlek is an industrial port area of Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It specialises in petrochemical logistics.

name: Maeslant Barrier

As part of the Delta Works, the barrier responds to water level predictions calculated by a centralized computer system called BOS. name: Kralingse Plas
wikipediaExtract:
The Kralingse Plas is a lake located in the suburb of Kralingen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. The water is mainly used for watersport, fishing and recreational activities. 
The Kralingse Plas was created due to peat extractions.

name: Berg- en Broekse Verlaat
wikipediaExtract: The Berg en Broeksche Verlaat is a canal lock in Rotterdam between the River Rotte and 2 peat bogs. It was built in 1866 and has Rijksmonument status.

name: Waalhaven
